definition.name: Offer
definition.description: Discount offers, BOGO deals, bundles, and promotional campaigns

fieldDefinitions.name: Title
fieldDefinitions.description: Display name of the offer (e.g., 'Summer BOGO Sale')

fieldDefinitions.name: Description
fieldDefinitions.description: Internal description or customer-facing details

fieldDefinitions.name: Offer Type
fieldDefinitions.description: BOGO | BUY_X_GET_Y | PERCENTAGE_OFF | FIXED_AMOUNT | PRODUCT_BUNDLE | COLLECTION_BUNDLE | VOLUME_TIERED | FREE_GIFT | SPEND_X_SAVE_Y | MIX_AND_MATCH | QUANTITY_BREAKS | MIN_QUANTITY

fieldDefinitions.name: Status
fieldDefinitions.description: ACTIVE | PAUSED | DRAFT | SCHEDULED | EXPIRED

fieldDefinitions.name: Pricing Display Mode
fieldDefinitions.description: DISCOUNT_ON_PRICE | AUTO_COMPARE_AT | CALC_FROM_COMPARE_AT | MANUAL_OVERRIDE

fieldDefinitions.name: Discount Value
fieldDefinitions.description: Percentage (e.g., 20 for 20%) or fixed amount (e.g., 10 for $10 off)

fieldDefinitions.name: Discount Type
fieldDefinitions.description: percentage | fixed_amount | free

fieldDefinitions.name: Buy Quantity
fieldDefinitions.description: For BOGO/BuyXGetY: number of items customer must buy

fieldDefinitions.name: Get Quantity
fieldDefinitions.description: For BOGO/BuyXGetY: number of free/discounted items

fieldDefinitions.name: Get Discount Percent
fieldDefinitions.description: Discount % on 'get' items (100 = free, 50 = half price)

fieldDefinitions.name: Bundle Price
fieldDefinitions.description: Fixed price for the entire bundle

fieldDefinitions.name: Bundle Save Percent
fieldDefinitions.description: Percentage saved vs individual prices

fieldDefinitions.name: Bundle Save Amount
fieldDefinitions.description: Fixed amount saved vs individual prices

fieldDefinitions.name: Spend Threshold
fieldDefinitions.description: For Spend X Save Y: minimum spend amount

fieldDefinitions.name: Mix Match Pick Count
fieldDefinitions.description: For Mix & Match: how many items customer picks (e.g., 3)

fieldDefinitions.name: Volume Tiers JSON
fieldDefinitions.description: JSON array of tiers: [{"min_qty": 3, "discount": 10}, {"min_qty": 5, "discount": 20}]

fieldDefinitions.name: Quantity Break Tiers JSON
fieldDefinitions.description: JSON array: [{"min_qty": 1, "price_each": 30}, {"min_qty": 3, "price_each": 25}]

fieldDefinitions.name: Min Quantity Required
fieldDefinitions.description: For Min Quantity Discount: minimum items needed

fieldDefinitions.name: Manual Price Override
fieldDefinitions.description: For MANUAL_OVERRIDE pricing mode: the display price

fieldDefinitions.name: Manual Compare At Price
fieldDefinitions.description: For MANUAL_OVERRIDE pricing mode: the compare-at price

fieldDefinitions.name: Target Products
fieldDefinitions.description: Products this offer applies to

fieldDefinitions.name: Target Collections
fieldDefinitions.description: Collections this offer applies to

fieldDefinitions.name: Gift Products
fieldDefinitions.description: For Free Gift / BOGO: the gift or 'get' products

fieldDefinitions.name: Popup Style
fieldDefinitions.description: NONE | ENTRY | EXIT_INTENT | CART_UPSELL | FLOATING_BAR | SLIDE_IN | PRODUCT_BANNER | COUNTDOWN_MODAL

fieldDefinitions.name: Popup Image
fieldDefinitions.description: Custom uploaded image for the popup/banner

fieldDefinitions.name: Badge Text
fieldDefinitions.description: Text shown on offer badges (e.g., 'BOGO!', 'Save 25%')

fieldDefinitions.name: Popup Trigger Delay
fieldDefinitions.description: Seconds before popup appears (0 = immediate)

fieldDefinitions.name: Popup Frequency
fieldDefinitions.description: EVERY_VISIT | ONCE_PER_SESSION | ONCE_PER_DAY | ONCE_EVER

fieldDefinitions.name: Show On Storefront
fieldDefinitions.description: Whether this offer is visible on the storefront

fieldDefinitions.name: Start Date
fieldDefinitions.description: When the offer becomes active

fieldDefinitions.name: End Date
fieldDefinitions.description: When the offer expires

fieldDefinitions.name: Priority
fieldDefinitions.description: Display priority (higher = shown first, 0 = default)

fieldDefinitions.name: Customer Target
fieldDefinitions.description: ALL | NEW_ONLY | RETURNING_ONLY

fieldDefinitions.name: Gamification Type
fieldDefinitions.description: NONE | SPIN_WHEEL | SCRATCH_CARD | PROGRESS_BAR

fieldDefinitions.name: Gamification Prizes JSON
fieldDefinitions.description: JSON array of prizes: [{"label": "10% Off", "code": "SPIN10", "probability": 30}]

fieldDefinitions.name: Cart Progress Goal
fieldDefinitions.description: Cart value target for progress bar (e.g., 100 for '$100 for free shipping')

fieldDefinitions.name: Cart Progress Message
fieldDefinitions.description: Message template: 'Spend {{remaining}} more for free shipping!'

fieldDefinitions.name: Social Proof Enabled
fieldDefinitions.description: Show stock countdown, recent purchases, etc.

fieldDefinitions.name: Stock Urgency Threshold
fieldDefinitions.description: Show 'Only X left!' when inventory drops below this number

fieldDefinitions.name: Translations JSON
fieldDefinitions.description: Multi-language: {"es": {"title": "...", "badge": "..."}, "fr": {...}}
